scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:player && npm run build:owner && npm run build:admin && npm run verify:build-isolation
scripts.deploy:player: npm run build:player && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/player/vercel.json', JSON.stringify({rewrites:[{source:'/(.*)',destination:'/index.html'}]}))" && vercel link --yes --project player --cwd dist/player && vercel deploy --prod --cwd dist/player
scripts.deploy:owner: npm run build:owner && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/owner/vercel.json', JSON.stringify({rewrites:[{source:'/(.*)',destination:'/index.html'}]}))" && vercel link --yes --project picklink-owner --cwd dist/owner && vercel deploy --prod --cwd dist/owner
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/admin/vercel.json', JSON.stringify({rewrites:[{source:'/(.*)',destination:'/index.html'}]}))" && vercel link --yes --project picklink-admin --cwd dist/admin && vercel deploy --prod --cwd dist/admin
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:player && npm run deploy:owner && npm run deploy:admin
